description: Implementation of a test tool for simulating and inspecting QUIC protocol frames, including a visitor class for handling various frame types and a framer class for processing packets.

classes.name: SimpleFramerVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class implementing QuicFramerVisitorInterface to handle and record various QUIC frame types during packet processing.

classes.name: SimpleQuicFramer
classes.description: A class that manages a QuicFramer instance and uses SimpleFramerVisitor to process and extract frames from QUIC packets.

methods.name: ProcessPacket
methods.description: Processes a QUIC encrypted packet using the framer and visitor.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the visitor to a new instance.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Returns the header of the last processed packet.

methods.name: version_negotiation_packet
methods.description: Returns the version negotiation packet if present.

methods.name: last_decrypted_level
methods.description: Returns the last decryption level of the processed packet.

methods.name: framer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the underlying QuicFramer instance.

methods.name: num_frames
methods.description: Returns the total number of frames processed.

methods.name: ack_frames
methods.description: Returns the list of ACK frames.

methods.name: stop_waiting_frames
methods.description: Returns the list of STOP_WAITING frames.

methods.name: path_challenge_frames
methods.description: Returns the list of PATH_CHALLENGE frames.

methods.name: path_response_frames
methods.description: Returns the list of PATH_RESPONSE frames.

methods.name: ping_frames
methods.description: Returns the list of PING frames.

methods.name: message_frames
methods.description: Returns the list of MESSAGE frames.

methods.name: window_update_frames
methods.description: Returns the list of WINDOW_UPDATE frames.

methods.name: stream_frames
methods.description: Returns the list of STREAM frames.

methods.name: crypto_frames
methods.description: Returns the list of CRYPTO frames.

methods.name: rst_stream_frames
methods.description: Returns the list of RST_STREAM frames.

methods.name: goaway_frames
methods.description: Returns the list of GOAWAY frames.

methods.name: connection_close_frames
methods.description: Returns the list of CONNECTION_CLOSE frames.

methods.name: padding_frames
methods.description: Returns the list of PADDING frames.

methods.name: coalesced_packet
methods.description: Returns the last coalesced packet processed.
